cohort: The study included 172 low-risk singleton pregnancies with cephalic presentation between 35 and 37+6 weeks gestation.
finding: Abnormal cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) was significantly associated with non-reassuring/abnormal CTG tracing and lower birth weight in low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean and operative vaginal delivery rates were comparable between the abnormal and normal CPR groups.
